procedure.semantic: Keep both prerequisites, advice strength, failure branch, no edits, and service B in all branches.
procedure.ste: Use condition-first steps, imperative actions where binding, sentences of at most 20 STE words, no semicolon, no perfect/progressive or new phrasal verbs, and a noun construction for test.
procedure.presentation: English instructions are self-contained and sequence is explicit.

description.semantic: Keep actor, yesterday, 12 local successes, unverified production, tentative cache and unknown cause.
description.ste: The content plan distinguishes descriptive statements from commands, keeps one topic per paragraph and avoids fabricated agents.
description.presentation: Use concise readable literary Chinese, retain clear referents and uncertainty.

safety.semantic: Preserve death risk, power disconnection before opening, seal damage, and solvent exclusion.
safety.ste: Distinguish warning from caution; give a command or condition first and the consequence; remove the command from the informational note; sentences at most 20 STE words.
safety.presentation: English safety instructions are clear without inventing hazards.

terminology.semantic: Preserve the full official term at first use, sync_control_panel, and the UI label verbatim.
terminology.ste: Apply the long technical noun exception with an explicitly introduced shorter term or justified grouping, not silent deletion.
terminology.presentation: Use the short term consistently and no extra operations.

modality.semantic: Keep not mandatory, recommendation, timeout uncertainty, status-first and only-confirmed-failure retry.
modality.ste: Reconstruct advice with approved wording instead of replacing should with must. Keep English conditions before actions and no semicolon.
modality.presentation: Chinese explanation uses literary clauses; English prompt can stand alone.

literals.semantic: Keep host, cwd, file, version branches, command and Chinese-key payload exact. Claim no execution.
literals.ste: Put host/cwd context before the steps; preserve machine syntax and literal data as protected material.

vocabulary.semantic: Keep test, personal protection, numeric threshold 20 psi, and stop action without execution claims.
vocabulary.ste: Check Part 2: test is a noun here; wear cannot mean clothing use; above cannot mean a numeric threshold. Use approved alternatives and preserve the numeric condition.
vocabulary.presentation: Use short English instructions with clear objects.

audit-status.semantic: Explain the available evidence and missing rule/dictionary verification without pretending the source exists.
audit-status.ste: Do not call a style checklist a full STE audit, certification, or vocabulary pass; state unresolved status.
audit-status.presentation: Give a brief literary Chinese report with an actionable missing-reference explanation.
